title: Data Visualization with an Agent
titleZh: 用 Agent 做数据可视化
summary: A challenge course — turn a clean sales dataset into three spec'd charts plus a summary.json whose numbers are verified against the data.
summaryZh: 一门挑战课程——把干净的销售数据变成三张有规格的图和一份 summary.json，其中数字与数据集校验一致。
outcome: A matplotlib script producing three valid PNG charts and a summary.json — the machine-checkable half of “here are my charts”, with an honest statement of what verification cannot see.
outcomeZh: 一个 matplotlib 脚本，产出三张合法 PNG 图和一份 summary.json——“这是我的图”中可机器核查的那一半，外加一句诚实说明验证看不到什么。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
uv or pip to install pinned pandas + matplotlib
Completing da-eda first is recommended, not required
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
用 uv 或 pip 安装锁定的 pandas + matplotlib
建议先完成 da-eda，非必需

lessons.title: A chart is packaged evidence
lessons.objective: State the claim behind each required chart before writing code — a wrong claim makes a pretty chart worse than none.
lessons.objectiveZh: 写代码前先说出每张图在声称什么——声称错了，图越漂亮越糟糕。

lessons.title: Spec first, chart second
lessons.objective: Map each output file to its source aggregation before letting the agent render anything.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在让 Agent 渲染之前，把每个输出文件映射到它的聚合来源。

lessons.title: Three charts and a summary
lessons.objective: Implement the contract in starter/charts.py — Agg backend, parsed dates, real PNG output.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在 starter/charts.py 里实现契约——Agg 后端、解析日期、产出真 PNG。

lessons.title: Numbers match the charts
lessons.objective: summary.json is the auditable layer — verified against dataset ground truth.
lessons.objectiveZh: summary.json 是可审计层——与数据集真值校验。

lessons.title: What verification cannot see
lessons.objective: Write the sentence stating what was and was not verified — the suite does not judge aesthetics or honest scales.
lessons.objectiveZh: 写下一句话说明验证了什么、没验证什么——套件不评价美观与坐标轴诚实性。

scenarios.title: Clean daily sales
scenarios.blurb: 135 rows of long-format daily revenue across three regions.
scenarios.blurbZh: 135 行长格式数据，三个地区的每日收入。

verification.method: Five-test contract suite: PNG magic bytes and file sizes, summary.json numbers against ground truth. The starter must reproduce the unfinished state.
verification.methodZh: 五个测试的契约套件：PNG 魔数与文件大小、summary.json 数字对真值。starter 必须复现未完成状态。
